question: Where should one recite the mantra to destroy planetary afflictions?
premises: Destruction of planetary affliction is the stated aim.
The proximity of an aśvattha tree is specified as the location.
inference: One should recite the mantra near an aśvattha tree to destroy planetary afflictions.
plain_english: To destroy planetary afflictions, one should recite the mantra in the presence of an aśvattha tree.
